content: Nhango ghwa kuatangatila ahyubhalila.
Hinu, kwa nnando ghula ghwa nhango kwakya bhandu bhahaghulitwe na Chapanga bha akwo ku Yelusalemu, ntende handa panualaghilite mangwemuko gha bhandu bhanhyubhalila Kilisito gha ku Galatia.

Kila mundu mu mwenga mu linjubha lya ulongolo lya Juma, kabhike ngalabha hya mayaghi pambwegha kulandana na lifungu lyake lya ngalabha ahyo hyakamokolite, ngati pakotoke kubhegha nhango pambala kuhika.
Pambala kuhika kwa mwenga, ndabhalaghila bhala bhampala kuahaghula mu mwenga bhayeghe mahamba na hupo hyenu ku Yelusalemu.
Handa payinoghwa mbaha kughenda na nenga, hinu, bhombe bhaalongohana papamu na nenga.
Npangilo ghwa Paulo
Ndahika akwo kwa mwenga mbole ya kupitila ku Mekodonia, kiyaha nunguhwachila kupitila huti ku Mekodonia.
Pangi ndaatama na mwenga kwa manjubha gha mandina, ebu pangi daatama papamu na mwenga mumanjubha ghoha gha malili ngati nhotole kundangatila ng'endelele na mwanja ghwangu kwoheli kumbala kughenda.
Mana mbala ng'obhe kutama na mwenga kwa manjubha gha mandina. Nunguhwachila kutama na mwenga kwa nndaluko ghwa kukwila, handa Bambo pakanemelela.
Peni hinu ndaahighala apa pa Efeso mbaka linjubha lya Pendekoste,
kiyaha nyughulighwa nlyango kwakya lihengo lyangu lya maha apa, payibhele apingika nabho abhegha tangalo.
Handa Timoteo kaahika kwa mwenga, kakingamwe telatela, ngati kakotoke kubhegha na bhwaghalili, kiyaha kangutenda lihengo lya Bambo handa nenga.
Kya habhu, mundu ywoheli kakotoke kumpughana, ngati muntangatile kaghendelele na mwanja ghwake kwa uhihimilo, kahotole kahike kwa nenga, mana nenga nungunnindila papamu na ahyubhalila ayetu.
Peni kwa nhalo ghwa Apolo, nnongo ghwetu, nunsigha muno kahike kwa mwenga papamu na ahyubhalila bhangi, peni kapala ng'obhe kuhika hino, ngati kaahika pakamokola ng'ebu.
Malagho gha kuyomolela
Mulindakile, nnyime nglii mu uhyubhalilo ghwenu, mmeghe ahwadali na mmeghite na makakala.
Kila kimukitenda mukitende kwa upalo.

Maalongo bhangu, mungumanya kukita Sitefano na bhandu lwa lubhagha lwake ndo bhakilongola huti kuyitikila uhyubhalilo ghwa Kilisito mu ku Akaya, na bhalitutumbula kuatumikila bhandu bhaaghulitwe kwakya Chapanga.
Muayitikile muno bhandu handa abho, peni bhubho mubhayitikile bhandu bhoha bhaabheghete mulihengo kwa kutenda na kutumika papamu nabho.
Nunguyelelwa muno kukita Stefano, na Fotunato na Akaiko bhahika apa, kiyaha bhalihibha lipengo lya ghwangabhegha mwenga.
Mana bhaghuyeleha nhuki ghwangu na nhuki ghwa mwenga bhubho. Kya habhu yingunohwa kuakulughwa bhandu handa bha modeli ya habhu.

Ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalila Kilisito bhanguajambuha bha ku Asia, bhanguajambuha. Akila na Pilisila papamu na bhandu bhoha bha Chapanga bhaabheghite ukaya kwabhe, bhanguajambuha muno mu kulilunga na Bambo.
Bhubho alongo bhoha bha apa bhanguajambuha. Na mwenga nnjambuhane kwa naho ya mapalo gha Yesu Kilisito.
Nenga Paulo nunguajambuha, ndyeka lihamba ali kwa kibhoko kyangu numwene.
Handa mundu ywoheli ywanganpala Bambo Yesu Kilisito, na kakundulwe. Malanata fwambulo yake Bambo Ghwetu ghuhike!
Umaha ghwa Bambo Yesu ghubheghe kwa mwenga.
Upalo ghwa nenga ghubheghe kwa mwenga mabhoha kwa kulilunga na Kilisito Yesu. Ayi Mwika.
